question.knowledge_point: Finding an Entry of the Product of Two Matrices
question.worked_solution:
Multiplying the $3$rd row in $Q$ by the $4$th column in $R$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{p}_{34} & =[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 & 4 & -5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 4 \\ 2 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\  & =4\cdot (-1)+(-2)\cdot 4+4\cdot 2+(-5)\cdot (-4) \\  & =-4-8+8+20 \\  & =16.\end{aligned}
$$
